data.name: Eschew Materials (Mythic)
data.description: You can cast even the most powerful spells without using material components. You can cast any spell with a material component costing gp or less without providing that component. If you expend one use of mythic power while casting a spell that requires a material component costing gp or less, you can cast it without providing that component. Expending two uses of mythic power instead allows you to cast a spell that requires a material component costing gp or less without providing that component.
